notes.title: 🔥Patch notes version 0.11.1🔥
notes.notes:
Ear protection and loot refactor
Today, we are releasing update 0.11.1 (patch notes below).

We are proud to introduce a community suggestion and finally be able to push out our loot refactor (giving us more flexibility on loot to improve on an area players have been requesting improvement).

Let’s get ear protection first. In Ghosts of Tabor, sounds are very important. Listening closely to footsteps, gun shots or voice chat can provide you an edge on the battlefield.

That is why we are introducing ear protection headsets. They will amplify some sounds while lowering others. Technically, high pitch sounds (footsteps, voice chat, some environmental sounds, …) will be amplified and some low pitch sounds (gun shots, explosions, …) will be lowered. This will allow you to clearly identify sounds that matter and, hopefully, improve your survival chances by making the right decisions at the right time based on the information you have.

[img src="https://scontent.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/499619145_2279131872538760_6490666831300011390_n.png?_nc_cat=103&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=v5n-C5JKELMQ7kNvwHF93Jb&_nc_oc=AdknkjXYfXMqyibPUeeV5OinY3g8fcEZCDnp-zkVuaQwDfwgt-lqC6DQS_RJDrOX4Tk&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_Afb9LA-6nbSnqQNeSwYjE_DzSIkztyJ1UXQhyPAFWUFy5A&oe=68BE2873"]

Now, on the loot refactor. One thing players have been asking since the early days (2 years ago) was to improve the loot spawn mechanics. We have been working on several iterations internally and really wanted to cook something that could evolve with the game over time while being easier for our game designer to balance when adding new items (balancing is never easy, but the tools are comprehensive and won’t require a dev to help him out). Loot boxes will spawn in various locations and items inside will not be as limited as previously. A large crate used to spawn large items only (not exactly, but accurate enough without getting in details) now, it might spawn several small items instead. Loot feels plentiful and it feels more rewarding to look through the spawned items to find the ones you want to bring home.

[img src="https://scontent.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/499620817_1304331997805154_6526966492808357926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=uDMLlAlD--0Q7kNvwFpNZR6&_nc_oc=AdnaKwluMukCV5z_eRtClvRg84ZQkXpTHnvMxymmF4nbrtN3Iwkwtr2-GZ4NkTNNuPs&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AfbdkRkaMAfU-l1yirHWdjCRgujE5-gFjJLy2oi473duqw&oe=68BE3F4D"]

notes.title: OPERATION INTEGRITY SWEEP : Wipe update 0.7.1
notes.notes:
At Combat Waffle Studios, we uphold a strict zero-tolerance stance against cheating in any of our games. Ensuring a fair gaming environment for our honest players is our paramount commitment, and we are continuously strengthening our anti-cheat measures.

Our recent efforts have been intensified with the addition of a dedicated anti-cheat specialist, who has played a pivotal role in fortifying our defenses in Ghosts of Tabor. As part of this initiative, we have replaced Easy Anti Cheat with the more robust BattlEye system. However, we understand that combating cheating is an ongoing battle.

To further reinforce our dedication, we have launched Operation Integrity Sweep. Leveraging BattlEye and our proprietary system "Project Resilience," we are actively rooting out cheaters from Ghosts of Tabor. Project Resilience has already identified and banned numerous individuals attempting to exploit the game in various ways over the past weeks. As a result, we have officially banned 47 cheaters/cheat developers from Ghosts of Tabor and all future CWS games.

Additionally, we are thrilled to introduce the Virtual Reality Integrity Coalition (VRIC). This groundbreaking initiative aims to revolutionize anti-cheating measures by establishing a collaborative network across VR platforms. By working with other game developers, we will implement a unified system within VRIC where penalties, such as bans, are shared across all participating games. A ban in Ghosts of Tabor will consequently apply to all other games within the VRIC network, magnifying the repercussions for dishonest behavior.

We extend our gratitude to all honest Taborites for their unwavering support and integrity. Together, let's maintain the integrity of Ghosts of Tabor and ensure it remains an equitable and enjoyable gaming environment for all. Happy gaming, and always remember to play fair or face the consequences.
-Scott
